text: Czech betting group Fortuna Entertainment Group (FEG) acquired a 70% controlling stake in TOPsport, announced March 2026; Lithuania's competition council cleared the deal and FEG confirmed completion in August 2026.

source.name: 15min.lt: „TOPsport“ parduodamas čekams: kas laukia Lietuvos futbolo?
source.note: Lithuanian. Translation: 'Fortuna Entertainment Group (FEG) acquired 70% of TOPsport shares' (typo 'Entertainmet' in the original). Article also details the pre-sale owners: Gintaras Staniulis 89.99% via Confluence Investment, remainder via Dainius Gulbinas's ALDA Holding.

additionalSources.name: iGamingWorld: Fortuna Entertainment Completes Acquisition of TOPsport
additionalSources.quote: has successfully completed its acquisition of a majority interest in TOPsport
additionalSources.note: Confirms formal closure (70%) of the deal announced in March 2026.
